name: Valerio Therapeutics Société anonyme
summary: Valerio Therapeutics Société anonyme, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, develops technology platforms dedicated to the targeted delivery of therapies. The company develops PlatON, a proprietary chemical platform for DNA decoy therapies, which generates new compounds and broadens its product portfolio; DecoyTAC, a mechanism of action of DNA decoy therapies coupled with targeted protein degradation; and V-body platform, a bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody drug conjugates, and chimeric antigen receptors.
